To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effect of nutrition on growth rate and body composition in the East African dwarf goat is not linear and that the relationship between body weight and carcass composition is non-linear.
the effects of nutrition on the carcass composition of goats are different from those in sheep and cattle.
the effect of nutrition on growth is to change the rate of growth, not the form of the growth curve.

the effects of different planes of nutrition on the composition of the carcass and on its quality, and with the relationship between the carcass and the live animal.
the effects of different patterns of growth on the carcass composition of the East African dwarf goat (EG).
the effects of contrasting planes of nutrition on the carcass composition of East African dwarf goats.
